# ghost/easy-notes

Easy Notes (F-Droid): create markdown notes, list, search and read them. Private, offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/easy-notes
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/easy-notes open_notes --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/easy-notes create_note --device <serial> --param title=<title> --param text=<text>
ghost skill run ghost/easy-notes list_notes --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/easy-notes read_note --device <serial> --param title=<title>
ghost skill run ghost/easy-notes search_notes --device <serial> --param query=<query>
```

## Actions

- `open_notes`: Open my Easy Notes list
- `create_note`: Create a note called Groceries in Easy Notes
- `list_notes`: List my notes in Easy Notes
- `read_note`: Read my note called Shopping list
- `search_notes`: Search my Easy Notes for milk
